ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Splash.cs:15-18) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars -- the three-option count is a literal on both sides.

OnPlay.issue: The three-options / upgrade-the-options / choose-one / free-this-turn / add-to-hand sequence is faithful, including that the upgrade is applied to the OPTIONS before the choice (Splash.cs:34-40 == colorless_skills.py:706-709) so the player sees upgraded cards, and that `SetToFreeThisTurn` precedes the pile add (53-54 == 712-714). THE POOL AND THE STREAM. C# builds its candidate list from `Owner.UnlockState.CharacterCardPools`, REMOVING the owner's own pool only when more than one character pool is unlocked (Splash.cs:25-29), then filters to Attacks. With a single unlocked character the own pool is kept, which is exactly the sim's situation -- so `random_pool_cards(..., CardType.ATTACK, ...)` over IRONCLAD_POOL is the CORRECT membership for the sim's Ironclad-only scope, and the sim's docstring says so. That half is faithful. WRONG RNG STREAM: C# names `Owner.RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration`; the sim draws on the unseeded shared `combat._rng` even though `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_gen` maps to `combat_card_generation` (combat_rng.py:20,52), and `random_pool_cards` uses `rng.sample` (pool.py:157-161) rather than GetDistinctForCombat's draw sequence. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/discovery's OnPlay entry (rule 3). LIVE, and this card is one of the 21 the `shared-rng` probe lists; card/infernal_blade and card/mad_science's Chaos rider show the correct shape. Also `canSkip: true` (Splash.cs:41) is not modelled: `CombatState.select_cards` always returns a card when candidates exist (combat.py:575-581), so the sim cannot decline -- dormant, the same residue as card/discovery's. REGRESSION TEST: `test/test_rng_tripwire.py:33` (`test_no_wrong_stream_draws_in_random_run`, 20 seeded full runs) is the standing gate for this whole family. It wraps `RunState.rng` and asserts ZERO in-combat draws on it; `CombatState` receives that same object as `self._rng` (run.py:1146-1148, combat.py:88), so a `ctx.combat._rng` draw taken from inside a card's `on_play` is recorded and fails the gate -- verified by playing this family's shape under a `Tripwire` and getting a hit at the `card.on_play` frame (combat.py:490). The gate is green today, so these 20 seeds never reach this card's draw; routing the site to the named `combat_rng` accessor is verified by keeping it green.

OnUpgrade.rationale: Splash.cs declares NO OnUpgrade override -- the upgrade changes no printed number, it upgrades the generated options, read from `IsUpgraded` inside OnPlay. The sim mirrors that exactly, including having no `_on_upgrade`. Same shape as card/armaments, card/cascade and card/primal_force. The sim's extra `if card.is_upgradable` test matches C#'s `CardCmd.Upgrade`, which self-checks IsUpgradable (CardCmd.cs:270-273).

guards.rationale: Test-only scaffolding, explicitly marked "ONLY USE THIS IN TESTS!", with no gameplay path. The same shape as card/discovery's `MockSelectedCard` and card/mad_science's `MockChaosCard`. Out of scope.
